AudioAppend.description: One chunk of recording audio: base64 PCM16, 24 kHz, mono.
AudioAppend.title: AudioAppend

AudioRead.description: The saved recording's length, in seconds (0 when there is none yet).
AudioRead.title: AudioRead

DailyNoteCreate.description:
The client's local date and the folder to hold today's note (Inbox
when omitted). The date must be a real calendar date, never a bare
string the user could not have meant.
DailyNoteCreate.title: DailyNoteCreate

DailyNoteRead.description:
Today's note, plus whether this call created it — the client can
tell "opened today's note" from "made today's note" in one response.
DailyNoteRead.title: DailyNoteRead

DictionaryTermsCreate.description: Terms parsed from the UI's one-per-line input.
DictionaryTermsCreate.title: DictionaryTermsCreate

EnhanceRequest.description: The options one enhance run may carry — both optional (Auto default).
EnhanceRequest.title: EnhanceRequest

EnhancedVersionRead.description: One saved enhanced version, as the client sees it.
EnhancedVersionRead.title: EnhancedVersionRead

EnhancedVersionUpdate.description: The field a version edit can change — just its content.
EnhancedVersionUpdate.title: EnhancedVersionUpdate

EntryCreate.description: A new blank note. When `folder_id` is omitted the note lands in Inbox.
EntryCreate.title: EntryCreate

EntryImageRead.description: One image's metadata — never the bytes, which /images/{id} serves.
EntryImageRead.title: EntryImageRead

EntryImageTitleUpdate.description: A new title for one image. Normalized like a note title.
EntryImageTitleUpdate.title: EntryImageTitleUpdate

EntryOutline.description:
The compact sidebar outline: transcript presence, chat titles, and
the note's images. Never the transcript, messages, or image bytes.
EntryOutline.title: EntryOutline

EntryRead.description:
One full entry: the human notes, the transcript, and the note's
images. Enhanced versions are read from /entries/{id}/enhanced-versions.
EntryRead.title: EntryRead

EntrySummary.description:
One history row — just enough to list, plus a one-line preview, its
tags (for folder chips and filtering), and its images (for the folder
view's thumbnails) — no extra requests.
EntrySummary.title: EntrySummary

EntryUpdate.description: The fields a note edit can change. `folder_id` moves the note.
EntryUpdate.title: EntryUpdate

FolderCreate.description: A new folder's name — trimmed and collapsed before it is stored.
FolderCreate.title: FolderCreate

FolderRead.description: One folder, exactly as the sidebar needs it.
FolderRead.title: FolderRead

FolderUpdate.description: Same shape as create — renaming follows the same rules.
FolderUpdate.title: FolderUpdate

KeyStatus.description: Whether a key is stored — a boolean only, never the key.
KeyStatus.title: KeyStatus

KeyUpdate.description: The OpenAI API key to store. The value never appears in a response.
KeyUpdate.title: KeyUpdate

LeetCodeSetupRead.description:
What the LeetCode starter run did — the flags let a second run
report "nothing to do" instead of duplicating anything.
LeetCodeSetupRead.title: LeetCodeSetupRead

OutlineChat.description: One chat row of a note's sidebar children.
OutlineChat.title: OutlineChat

OutlineImage.description: One image of a note — the id for the file endpoint plus its title.
OutlineImage.title: OutlineImage

SettingsUpdate.description: The preferences to save (all of them, like the /me PUT).
SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate

TagRead.description: A note's tags after a replace — the server's normalized truth.
TagRead.title: TagRead

TagRename.description: A tag's new display value. Normalized server-side, like on save.
TagRename.title: TagRename

TagReplace.description:
The complete replacement set of tags for one note. Values are
normalized server-side; there is no count cap.
TagReplace.title: TagReplace

TemplateCreate.description: The fields a new custom template needs — only the name is required.
TemplateCreate.title: TemplateCreate

TemplateRead.description: One template, as the client sees it.
TemplateRead.title: TemplateRead

TemplateUpdate.description: The fields a template edit can change — all optional.
TemplateUpdate.title: TemplateUpdate

TitleRead.description: One suggested title. The client confirms it before anything is saved.
TitleRead.title: TitleRead

TranscriptLineRead.description: One finished utterance — the transcript bubble.
TranscriptLineRead.title: TranscriptLineRead

TranscriptRead.description: The entry's transcript, utterance by utterance.
TranscriptRead.title: TranscriptRead

post.description:
Today's note: the same call always lands on the same note for one
date — created on the first call, returned ever after.

Response Read Versions Entries  Entry Id  Enhanced Versions Get

post.description:
Store one picture on the note. Only declared image types are taken,
and anything over MAX_IMAGE_BYTES is refused before it is read.

delete.description:
Delete one picture. The note keeps any markdown reference; the
preview simply renders nothing for a missing image id.

get.description:
The picture itself — served straight from the row with its own
content type, so previews and thumbnails need no extra encoding.

patch.description: Rename one picture (null clears the title back to untitled).

get.description: The compact sidebar outline: transcript presence and chat titles.

post.description:
Suggest one title from the note's own content. A suggestion is never
saved — the client shows it for confirmation and reuses the rename flow.

put.description: Replace the note's tags with exactly this list (normalized).

delete.description:
Delete the tag from every note. A missing tag resolves to the same
outcome, so the call is idempotent.

patch.description:
Rename the tag everywhere. A blank name is rejected; renaming onto
an existing tag merges the two into one.

post.description:
Create the LeetCode folder and its starter note once. Re-running
reports what exists — it never duplicates the folder or the note.
